text: The project balances two sides of commerce. The customer needs clarity at the moment of choice, while the operator needs visibility after the purchase.

text: The architecture is deliberately understandable. Routes handle the page, the bootstrap centralises shared behavior, the database stores the model, and assets stay separate from application logic.

text: The safeguards shown here are grounded in the project structure: session handling, admin gates, prepared database statements, upload helpers, logging and local configuration overrides.
